comparison.objective: Open a beverage can using its stay-on tab.
comparison.physical_skill: Pinch a recessed tab and lift it about its rivet so its lever depresses the scored panel.
comparison.success_condition: Panel folds inward at least 45 degrees with the tab raised; directly poking the panel does not qualify.
comparison.reason: Both involve breaking a manufactured weak feature, but the can tests direct lever actuation of a retained panel; the candidate tests bimanual hammer impact through a mandrel plus recovery of four detached fragments.
